title: All seventy Hanford transition-requirement checks remain unmet
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: Fourteen transitions are evaluated against five evidence requirements; none establishes stable identity, dated transfer, compatible method and units, or quality and acceptance state. Denominator: Fourteen transitions by five requirements: seventy checks.
